name: What kind of maintenance is required after laminate flooring installation?
description: Maintain laminate by sweeping or vacuuming regularly and cleaning spills with a damp cloth and laminate cleaner. Avoid abrasive cleaners or excessive water.

mainEntity.name: What kind of maintenance is required after laminate flooring installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Laminate flooring is known for its low maintenance. Regular cleaning involves sweeping or vacuuming with a soft brush attachment to remove dust and debris. For spills or light cleaning, use a damp mop or cloth with a laminate-specific cleaner, avoiding excessive water. Do not use abrasive cleaners, wax, or steam cleaners, as these can damage the finish. Placing felt pads under furniture legs and using doormats at entrances helps prevent scratches and extend the life of your floor.
